prompt: When did Sienna see four seats available?
promptZh: Sienna 何時看到還有四席？

options.whyZh: 中午是兌換期限，並非查看座位的時間。
這是她可以抵達的時間。
訊息明說上午十點看見四席。

explanationZh: 訊息明說上午十點看見四席。
evidence:
Document 2 · Message from Sienna
To: Jules
I can get there at 6:10. Please choose the screening with captions. I received only one voucher, but we both need seats. The website showed four seats left at 10 this morning. Could you take care of the tickets before lunch? If you can only get one seat, don’t redeem the voucher yet. I’d rather move it to next Wednesday than go alone.

vocabulary.note: 目前仍可購入或預約的座位。
